description.value: Main/subfeed breaker kit for QJ2, QJH2 and QJ2-H breakers in Revised P1 panelboards, 1-phase 2/3-wire; breaker purchased separately

application.value: Main or subfeed in panels rated 250 A or less; subfeed ONLY in panels above 250 A (P1-400)

fasteners.value: 1/4-20x1/2 hex SEMS; #10-24x1/2 slotted hex washer thread-forming; 1/4-20 belleville washer nut; 1/4-20x3-1/4 slotted round head

log: Listed the public dcc-data-extract bucket prefix 'Instruction Sheet Quick Guide/SIE_IS' (1,274 keys, paginated). Excluded the 142 files already cited in data/sources.json, leaving 1,133; filtered to ~222 distribution-hardware sheets (panel/switchboard kits, breaker lug/terminal/stud/plug-in/shield kits) and downloaded them to docs/library/_incoming/B0014-siemens-instruction-sheets/. Many 'new' filenames were re-uploads of documents already processed under other names (11-A-1134, 11-A-1180, 11-B-1086/1097, 11-A-1168, S3VA41*, DFFPVA*, 11-B-1012 6JJ61/SJ1D..., SC*/SF*_old 31-12xx, F657/F671, SDG/SJG/SQR/SBL/SNB) and were skipped. New panel/switchboard documents processed: 11-A-1112-01 (MBKQJ1A/3A), 11-A-1130-01 (MBKQR1A/3A), 11-A-1118-01 (RP1 400A OEM chassis K-11-D-2554..2557), 11-A-1181-01 (DFFPED01/FD01/QJ01/QJ02 piece nos.), 11-B-1011-01 (SQJD/6QJ2/SQJ), 11-B-1015-01 (SJ1/SSJ1/SL6/SSL6), 11-B-1017-01 (SMND), 11-B-1018-01 (NG1D), 11-D-1023-01 (SMSKHCP), Series 5/6 drawings via 31-1153/1154/1187/1189/1194/1195 (6CLE2, 6CLF1, 6CLJ1, 6CLL1, 6SCJ1, 6SCL1 with full BOMs, Siemens piece numbers and Series 5 adaptor kits 11-5570-01/-02), 31-1157/1158/1159 (VB657/VB671/VB6150), 12-B-2018-01 (VB610), 12-B-2016/2017-01 (F672/F672D), 31-1243-01 (F6150D), 12-B-2108-01 (F6162D 800/1200A HCP), 31-1209/1223/1226 (SSCJ, SJ2D, SSCJD), 12-C-1010-01 (Blue Pennant PLL44/46/48). Breaker accessory sheets (ED/FD/JD/LD/LMD/MD/ND/PD/RD/QJ/QR/NGG/CQD and VL DG..PG) processed from text layers; scanned ones read visually. F6162_old drawing text used a reversed-codepoint font (decoded char=0x120-code). No OCR available (tesseract absent); image sheets rendered with pdftoppm and read visually. Target 3: SPEEDFAX US Section 12 p.12-32 not found as such, but SPEEDFAX 2011 Section 13 pp.13-11..13-20 (assets.usesi.com USESI_93254_catalog.pdf) contains the same 'Switchboard Replacement Parts and Modification Kits' table (connection strap kits by breaker type, amp rating, unit height, twin/single; Vacu-Break/HCP kits; blank plates; SMM meter socket kits MSK2001/2003; SMM connecting kits SMM*MK) plus Super Blue Pennant kits. Target 2 (ITE/Siemens-Allis): no new ITE-era documents found beyond the Series 5/6 drawings embedded in the 31-11xx sheets. Failures: BNK2 file is an HTML error page (deleted locally); SMND_SSMND.pdf corrupt. Out-of-scope sheets listed in leads.
